tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read the account that owns this API key, including plan, limits, today's usage, and the prepaid credit balance in USD.

tools.name: list_shows
tools.description: List this account's daily podcast show. An account has at most one show.

tools.name: get_show
tools.description: Get one daily podcast show by id.

tools.name: create_show
tools.description: Create this account's daily podcast show from X accounts and topics. Fails if a show already exists. Language defaults to English. tools.name: update_show
tools.description: Replace the daily show's name, X accounts, topics, language, voice, timezone, and delivery time. The same plan limits as create apply. topic_apply fills accounts from topics up to the Free or Pro cap. This does not change the subscription.

tools.name: generate_episode

tools.name: get_episode_audio
tools.description: Get a temporary MP3 URL for a ready daily episode. The URL expires in six hours. Audio past the retention window returns 410.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_episode_audio, create_script_audio_job, get_script_audio_download, estimate_content_episode, create_content_episode, list_content_episodes, get_content_episode, get_content_episode_audio, delete_content_episode · Private data: get_account, delete_episode, estimate_content_episode, create_content_episode, list_content_episodes, get_content_episode, get_content_episode_audio, delete_content_episode · Public sink: list_library, estimate_content_episode, create_content_episode, list_content_episodes, get_content_episode, get_content_episode_audio, delete_content_episode, create_episode_share, revoke_episode_share · Destructive: delete_episode, estimate_content_episode, delete_content_episode, revoke_episode_share.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_episode_audio, create_script_audio_job, get_script_audio_download, estimate_content_episode, create_content_episode, list_content_episodes, get_content_episode, get_content_episode_audio, delete_content_episode · Private data: get_account, delete_episode, estimate_content_episode, create_content_episode, list_content_episodes, get_content_episode, get_content_episode_audio, delete_content_episode · Public sink: list_library, estimate_content_episode, create_content_episode, list_content_episodes, get_content_episode, get_content_episode_audio, delete_content_episode, create_episode_share, revoke_episode_share · Destructive: delete_episode, estimate_content_episode, delete_content_episode, revoke_episode_share

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "estimate_script_audio" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
